firm_data.firm_description: Bousquet Holstein PLLC is a versatile law firm representing clients across many industries. The firm’s clientele is comprised of businesses and individual clients for whom they provide legal advice and counsel on a broad range of matters covering more than 30 different practice areas.
notable_facts: Firm has offices in Syracuse and Ithaca, New York.
The firm was founded by Larry Bousquet, Phil Bousquet, and David Holstein.

email.subject: AI for Bousquet Holstein, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Lisa,

With 58 attorneys across Syracuse and Ithaca handling everything from M&A to brownfields work, Bousquet Holstein manages the kind of complex, multi-practice workload that demands precision and efficiency without bloating overhead.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding into New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
